_comment: LoRA data table (2026-09-30 owner model). One entry per known LoRA (id / path / owner / default strengths / description). `owner` routes it: 'model' (template-private, e.g. /换脸), 'Plugin' (plugin-owned, e.g. viggle), 'none' (public manager). `path` is the weight origin; a template references the unified-dir relative name (<comfy_root>/models/loras). Absent owner = 'none'. Entries with no owner and runtime-scanned weights are owned by the lora-manager plugin.
